description:
## Features

### YouTube Music - Visual preferences icons
- **New `Icon style` option:** `Regular` (default) or `Bold`. `Bold` draws the Settings menu icons, the RVX sub-settings icons and the RVX entry with a heavier line weight, like the YouTube patch. The `RVX letters (bold)` and coloured RVX icons keep their own look. Set it under the patch options in Morphe Manager, then re-patch.

## Bug Fixes

### YouTube Music - Crossfade
- **`Repeat one` works with `Crossfade on auto-advance`:** on YouTube Music 9.40 and newer the repeat state was reset by playback and shuffle events, so the next track started instead of the same one. Ported from Morphe (MorpheApp/morphe-patches#3916).

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.10.3...v1.10.4)
